title: Earth Wall Crusher
body:
Syntax: perform earth wall crusher <target>

Description: A Ninjutsu jutsu, unlocked at level 20. 24-29 raw damage -- an upfront Earth hit without a lingering status effect. Costs 20 Chakra, 5 second cooldown.

Requires your own chakra nature (primary or secondary) to genuinely be Earth -- this jutsu cannot be cast at all otherwise, even if it shows up in your learned skills.

Date: 2026-08-24
